findings.text: A send delay of 1.5 s does not survive a reload. `ext/Chat/Mic.js:39-40` deletes saved `pause_send_ms`/`paragraph_pause_ms` values of 1500 (and 700) on every load, including loads from the new `.4` key, so the owner's own 1.5 s pick snaps back to 2 s. The 0.5 s steps in the input make 1.5 an obvious choice. Only strip stale defaults when migrating from `.3`/`.2`, then add a 1.5 s case to `test/settings.mjs` (it only tries 3 and 0.5, which is how this slipped through).

The screenshots are not committed. `shots/panel-400.png` and `shots/panel-1920.png` exist in worktree `qf-3`, but `git ls-files` for the task folder lists only `requirements.md` and `session.jsonl`. `doc/settings.md:20` says "Shots in the task folder's `shots/`", so that link breaks on merge. Add them by path.

`ext/Chat/doc/mic-notes.md` is now stale. The "paragraph_pause_ms history" section still ends at the owner's 2026-10-01 "500 to 1000 ms" (700), and line ~350 still quotes "(700ms)". Nothing there says that both waits became one 2 s "send delay" on 2026-10-25, that the store moved to `.4`, or that `doc/settings.md` exists. Add one history line and a link. Whoever reads it next will otherwise think the owner's 700 ms ask still holds.

The owner's Part 7.6 ask comes first, but the panel buries it. "send delay" is row 5 of 11, below send mode and sentences per send (`shots/panel-400.png`, middle band). The owner asked for "a small settings panel: the delay before sending … and the other knobs". Moving the send delay to the top row, and maybe the expert knobs (guess, safety chunks, fillers) under a fold, would match those words better.

The smart assistant's default stays at 6 s. The owner's Part 10 says batches go "every ~10–15 s", and the brief said 12. The minion logged this as out of fence (`Servex/agents/WakePolicy.js` `WAKE_DEFAULTS`). The parent should route it, or the owner's number never lands.

The new 2 s default changes `SETTINGS` for every composer on the site, not just the sheet, and every saved 700/1500 value gets wiped. That fits the owner's "say 2 s", but it reverses the 2026-10-01 "500 to 1000 ms" ask. Say so in the landing line.
The ⚙ is created only when `!this.compact` (`DictationBar.js:93`), so the compact bar has no way into settings. Fine if compact never needs it. One line in `doc/settings.md` would say so.

The `push_wake` call in `chat.js:170` relies on `panel.dictate`, and `Widget.js:786` relies on the Widget keeping its `session` option as `w.session`. `test/settings.mjs` proves both work (the POST reaches the stub session), so this only matters if Widget stops assigning its options.
